comment: Stray minutes (canon section 2): a starter set; the minutes pass grows the book to 150+.

reward.text: The Kitchen Minutes page is full. It smells faintly of toast and warm tea, and Mott, when he hears, says it's the coziest page in the book.
The Minutes of Waiting page is full, and all its small impatiences settle into one long, contented sigh. Tucked in the spine is a dreamseed.

collectibles.name: the kettle minute
collectibles.text: the minute spent watching a kettle that would not boil

collectibles.name: the toast minute
collectibles.text: the minute between the toaster's tick and the toast popping up

collectibles.name: the last-biscuit minute
collectibles.text: the minute two people spent politely not taking the last biscuit

collectibles.name: the steam minute
collectibles.text: the minute a cup of tea was too hot to drink and too good to leave

collectibles.name: the fridge-light minute
collectibles.text: the minute spent standing in front of an open cupboard, forgetting what for

collectibles.name: the dough minute
collectibles.text: the minute a grandmother's hands showed someone how to knead

collectibles.name: the recipe minute
collectibles.text: the minute someone found a recipe card in a handwriting they missed

collectibles.name: the washing-up minute
collectibles.text: the minute two people washed and dried in easy silence

collectibles.name: the post minute
collectibles.text: the minute spent listening for the letterbox to clack

collectibles.name: the rain-stop minute
collectibles.text: the minute under an awning waiting for the rain to ease

collectibles.name: the results minute
collectibles.text: the minute before a name was read out

collectibles.name: the doorway minute
collectibles.text: the minute in a doorway waiting for someone to turn and wave

collectibles.name: the oven-door minute
collectibles.text: the minute of not opening the oven door to look

collectibles.name: the knock minute
collectibles.text: the minute after a knock, before the door opened

collectibles.name: the first-snow minute
collectibles.text: the minute at the window waiting to see if it would really snow

collectibles.name: the sneeze minute
collectibles.text: the minute before a sneeze that never came
